title: Translation Log
description: Record of pattern identification and translation decisions. 'entries' is keyed by pattern name; each value is an array of LogEntry objects for that pattern. 'sinkCandidates' is a map of node path → subgraph metadata.

entries.description: Translation log entries grouped by pattern name.

sinkCandidates.description: Sink candidate metadata keyed by node path.

edgeId.description: Source-specific identifier tying this entry to an edge in the rule graph and to the originating source artifact. Format is source-specific (e.g. 'file.ers:N' for Corticon). Present on rule-level findings; omitted on node-level findings that span multiple rules.

node.description: Canonical attribute path this entry applies to (e.g. 'Person.age'). Omitted for sheet-level findings not tied to a specific output node.

pattern.description: Classifier identifying which rule pattern was detected. See translation-patterns.yaml for the full list.

variant.description: Sub-type of the pattern when applicable.

status.description: Confidence level. confirmed=translation is known correct; inferred=relies on unverified assumptions; unsupported=cannot be translated; error=translation failed.

translated.description: True if this pattern produced a node or expression in the rule graph.

raw.description: What the source system declared for this node/edge. Include whenever source type or expression is known. 'type' is the source system's own type name (e.g. Corticon: 'Integer', 'Date', 'CC_RSN', entity class name for constructor patterns). 'expression' is the raw source text before compilation.

expression.description: Raw source expression(s). String when single, array when multiple rules contributed.

compiled.description: What was produced in the graph. Omit when translated:false. 'type' is the JSON Schema type; 'format'/'enum'/'entityType' follow JSON Schema conventions matching the graph node definition. 'expression' is the compiled CEL expression.

note.description: Human-readable explanation or warning when the translation decision is non-obvious.

excludedEdgeIds.description: For no-writer pattern: the edge IDs (rulesheet paths) that were excluded (entity-creation, unreachable, etc.), leaving no valid writer for this node.

nodes.description: All node paths in this candidate's subgraph, for search/navigation.

orderedLayers.description: Nodes grouped by BFS depth layer (index 0 = sink), each layer ordered for minimal edge crossings. Used for subgraph SVG layout.

edges.description: Directed {from, to} pairs within this candidate's subgraph. Used for SVG arrow rendering.
